title: fix: bump uuid to v11 and postcss to 8.5.14 for security
body:
## Summary
- Adds `overrides` in `package.json` to force `uuid` from 8.3.2 → 11.1.1 across all transitive dependencies
- Bumps `postcss` from 8.5.9 → 8.5.14 (security patch)

## Test plan
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
